messages:
erin: Heads-up — OrbitSec engineering reached out about a joint marketplace listing + launch announcement. They want to tie our Private offering into their secrets manager (SCM) + HSM-backed KMS flow. Quick sync to scope technical blockers?
kamal: Sounds good. Do we have a partner SSO/SAML flow for demos? We should avoid sharing prod creds.
ders: We can use our demo tenant + test KMS keys. Need to confirm OrbitSec can accept our SP metadata and support SCIM user provisioning.
sarah: OrbitSec asked for two things: 1) SAML SP metadata (we provide), 2) SCIM user/group mapping for role-based access to secrets. Also they want envelope encryption examples for KMS integration.
erin: Proposed timeline from their PM: partner preview next Tue, joint press + marketplace tile 2 weeks after. Legal wants a 72h embargo window for any press copy.
kamal: Technical checklist I'd like: SAML metadata exchange, ACS URL, NameID format, cert rotation plan; SCIM schema + group-to-role map; KMS integration: key wrapping vs. direct HSM-protected keys and attestation requirements; audit/logging endpoints.
sarah: Adding onboarding steps: staging onboarding guide, test vectors (create/read/delete secret), sample SCIM payloads, and a small demo app that shows SSO into OrbitSec and secrets fetch using our KMS-wrapped key.
erin: Can @kamal own the SAML + cert rotation doc? @devon can you draft the SCIM payloads + sample mapping? I'll coordinate marketing copy and embargo with legal.
devon: Yep. I'll start a minimal SCIM mapping doc. Quick question: do we support SCIM PATCH operations for group membership changes?
kamal: We do support PATCH but need to validate partial attribute updates for nested groups. I'll document edge cases.
sarah: For KMS/HSM: OrbitSec wants to do an HSM attestation check during onboarding. We need to share our attestation statement and key policy template. Devon — can you include the key policy example?
devon: On it. Also will add a minimal key usage example: 
```
# Create envelope key
curl -X POST https://private.redwood.ai/kms/v1/keys -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"purpose":"ENVELOPE","hsm_profile":"yubihsm-v1"}'
```
erin: Nice. Ops note: staging region for partner preview should be eu-west-1 — OrbitSec sales wants EU data residency for the demo. @marketplace-bot can you confirm marketplace tile requirements (assets, logos, copy length)?
marketplace-bot: Marketplace listing checklist: logo 600x400 PNG, 1-paragraph summary (<=200 chars), 2 screenshots, integration tags: SSO, SCIM, KMS, HSM, Private. Submission slot: 3 business days for review.
kamal: One more risk: cert rotation cadence. OrbitSec requires <90d certs for SP metadata. We need to confirm our automation for cert rollover won't break active sessions. I'll add a canary plan.
sarah: Also surface to trust & security: audit log retention for cross-account events (we need 90 days for them). Erin, legal asked about export controls for HSM firmware — I'll loop in security.
erin: Action items: (1) kamal — SAML/cert rotation doc by EOD tomorrow, (2) devon — SCIM payloads + key policy examples by EOD, (3) sarah — staging runbook + attestation artifacts, (4) erin — marketing/legal embargo + announcement draft. OrbitSec wants a tech call Thu 2pm PT. Can everyone make that?
kamal: I can. :thumbsup:
devon: I can.
sarah: Yes.
erin: Great. I'll send calendar invite and drop initial doc links here when created. Thanks — let's keep the thread for quick updates. :white_check_mark:
